title: Philippines withdraws from ICC
description: The Philippines officially withdrew from the Rome Statute, the treaty that established the International Criminal Court.

title: ICC withdrawal becomes effective
description: The Philippines' withdrawal from the ICC Rome Statute takes effect one year after notification.

title: ICC Pre-Trial Chamber authorizes investigation
description: The ICC Pre-Trial Chamber authorized an investigation into alleged crimes against humanity in the Philippines.

title: Sara Duterte assumes office as Vice President
description: Sara Duterte was inaugurated as the 15th Vice President of the Philippines.
